turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. You asked for this meeting, so start with why my son's grade went to zero before anyone called me.
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." You asked for this meeting, Hale, and I have a call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.

You asked for this meeting, Hale, and you're not walking out of it without answering me. Either the zero comes off today, or you show me something with a date on it. Otherwise my next stop is the principal's office.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I'm writing that down: no call before the zero, and no reason given today. I'm not emailing anyone, Hale. I'm going upstairs to the principal now, and I'll want that zero withdrawn in writing.
